name: Twinned
source: Pathfinder Howl of the Wild, Twinned adjustment (pg. 123), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=28
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Howl of the Wild is ORC licensed material.
rules: Adds a second head: Independent Brains (each head takes its own turn), Gnaw Free and Reactive Strike.

abilities.name: Independent Brains
abilities.description: Each of {name}'s heads rolls its own initiative and has its own turn. Neither head can Delay. At the start of a head's turn, that head gets 2 actions and 1 reaction. Each brain can control the creature's body normally. Taking damage equal to half its Hit Points ({halfHp} HP) or any ability that would sever one of its heads (such as the vorpal weapon property) destroys one head and causes {name} to lose the turns, actions, and reactions of the severed head. Mental effects that target a single creature affect only one of its heads.

abilities.name: Gnaw Free
abilities.description: Trigger {Name}'s other head attempts to Escape; Effect This head bites its grappler or restraints to help the other head break free. {Name} gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its Escape check.
